bind -N "scode for current dir (repo-aware coding layout)" 9 \
  run-shell -b "~/.config/tmux/scode-here.sh '#{pane_current_path}'"

# prefix + 0: lightweight counterpart to prefix+9. Plain sesh session at
# the git root of the current pane's directory (no nvim/agent layout).
# Replaces tmux's built-in `select-window -t :=0` which always errored
# because base-index is 1 (no window 0 exists). Logic in sesh-root-here.sh
# — see that file for the two bugs in the original `sesh connect --root
# $(pwd)` binding (parse-time $(pwd) + misuse of --root flag).
bind -N "sesh-root for current dir (lightweight)" 0 \
  run-shell -b "~/.config/tmux/sesh-root-here.sh '#{pane_current_path}'"

# prefix + T: sesh picker via television (tv) in a tmux popup
bind-key "T" display-popup -E -w 80% -h 70% -d '#{pane_current_path}' -T ' Sesh (tv) ' "tv sesh"

# prefix + O: sesh built-in picker in a tmux popup

# prefix + U: CLI tools picker via television (tv tools)
bind-key "U" display-popup -E -w 80% -h 70% -d '#{pane_current_path}' -T ' CLI Tools (tv) ' "tv tools"

#   docs/tools/agent-panes-discovery.md

MISE_BIN="${HOME}/.local/bin/mise"
[[ ! -x "$MISE_BIN" ]] && MISE_BIN="$(command -v mise 2>/dev/null || true)"
if [[ -x "$MISE_BIN" ]] && [[ -f "$HOME/.config/mise/config.toml" ]]; then
    info "Installing mise global tools..."
    if "$MISE_BIN" install --yes; then
        success "mise tools installed"
    else
        warn "mise install had errors (some tools may have failed to build). Continuing..."
    fi
fi

# 7. Ensure ~/.local/bin is on PATH for bash sessions (idempotent)
# chezmoi, uv, mise all live in ~/.local/bin. Dotfiles only wire this up in
# zsh; until the user switches shells, bash needs help finding them.
BASHRC="$HOME/.bashrc"
LOCAL_BIN_LINE='export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"'
if [[ -f "$BASHRC" ]] || [[ "${SHELL##*/}" == "bash" ]]; then
    touch "$BASHRC"
    if ! grep -qF "$LOCAL_BIN_LINE" "$BASHRC"; then
        {
            echo ""
            echo "# Added by chezmoi bootstrap - ~/.local/bin for uv, mise, chezmoi"
            echo "$LOCAL_BIN_LINE"
        } >> "$BASHRC"
        info "Added ~/.local/bin to PATH in $BASHRC"
    fi
fi

success "Bootstrap complete!"

=== agent-panes ===
# Live agent panes cable channel for television (tv)
#
# Discovers coding-agent sessions currently running inside any tmux pane and
# lets you jump straight to them. Companion to `agent-sessions.toml` (which
# browses STORED sessions). Backed by `agent-sessions.py panes`.
#
# Usage:
#   tv agent-panes
#   prefix + a (inside tmux)
#
# Source: 9-col TSV from `agent-sessions.py panes`:
#   0. agent tag       ([cc] / [cx] / [oc] / [cu])
#   1. when            (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, last activity)
#   2. session id      (full id; empty for non-Claude when no cwd match)
#   3. directory       (cwd of the pane; "?" when unknown)
#   4. title/snippet   (Claude session name, or first non-system user msg)
#   5. specstory_path  (matching .specstory/history/*.md, when present)
#   6. pane target     (session:win.pane — passed to tmux switch-client)
#   7. pane pid        (tmux pane_pid; for diagnostics)
#   8. status glyph    (●=busy / ○=idle for Claude; empty otherwise — pre-
#                       rendered in Python because TV's display template
#                       does not support per-column substitution)
#
# Keybindings:
#   Enter      Switch tmux focus to that pane (session, window, pane)
#   Alt+T      Same as Enter (T for "take over" — mirrors agent-sessions.toml)
#   Alt+K      Kill the pane (confirm prompt)
#   Ctrl+Y     Copy pane target (session:win.pane) to clipboard
#   Alt+P      Copy directory path to clipboard
#   Alt+R      Copy session id to clipboard
#   Alt+S      Copy matched .specstory/history/*.md path to clipboard
#
# Preview cycling (Ctrl+F):
#   1. Live tmux capture-pane snapshot (last ~80 lines of the pane).
#   2. Stored transcript (delegates to agent-sessions.py transcript mode).

[metadata]
name = "agent-panes"
description = "Live coding-agent panes across tmux — jump to a running claude/codex/opencode/cursor session"
requirements = ["tmux", "python3"]

[source]
command = "~/.config/television/agent-sessions.py panes"
# Display: agent + status glyph + pane target │ snippet │ short cwd
# Glyph (col 8) is pre-rendered in Python — see comment in agent-sessions.py
# `_build_pane_row`. TV silently breaks ALL `{split:}` substitutions in the
# same string when it sees unrecognised syntax (e.g. `s/busy/●/`).
display = "{split:\t:0} {split:\t:8} {split:\t:6}  │  {split:\t:4}  │  {split:\t:3|split:/:-1}"
output = "{split:\t:6}"

[preview]
command = [
  # Preview 1 (default): live capture-pane snapshot.
  # Shows what's actually on screen in that pane RIGHT NOW — the most useful
  # thing when you're about to jump to it.
  '''
  target='{split:\t:6}'; agent='{split:\t:0}'; sid='{split:\t:2}'; pane_status='{split:\t:8}'; pid='{split:\t:7}'
  # NB: `status` is read-only in zsh ($? alias) — DO NOT rename `pane_status` back to `status`.
  printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m  pane=%s  pid=%s  %s\n' "$agent" "$target" "$pid" "$pane_status"
  printf '\033[2msession:\033[0m  %s\n' "$sid"
  printf '\033[2mcwd:\033[0m      %s\n' '{split:\t:3}'
  printf '\n\033[1m─── live pane (capture-pane -ep) ───\033[0m\n'
  tmux capture-pane -ep -t "$target" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 80 \
    || echo "(pane $target no longer exists — picker is stale; press Ctrl+R to reload)"
  ''',
  # Preview 2: stored transcript (markdown-rendered).
  # `glow --style auto` degrades to plain when stdout is a pipe (which is
  # always true in TV's preview pane); force `--style dark` to keep ANSI.
  # Width is taken from $TV_PREVIEW_WIDTH if TV exports it, else COLUMNS.
  '''
  agent='{split:\t:0}'; sid='{split:\t:2}'
  case "$agent" in
    "[cc]") tag=cc ;;
    "[cx]") tag=cx ;;
    "[oc]") tag=oc ;;
    *) tag="" ;;
  esac
  if [ -z "$tag" ] || [ -z "$sid" ]; then
    printf '\033[2m(no stored transcript for %s — use preview 1 for live pane content.)\033[0m\n' "$agent"
    exit 0
  fi
  W="${TV_PREVIEW_WIDTH:-${COLUMNS:-100}}"
  if command -v glow >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    "$HOME/.config/television/agent-sessions.py" transcript "$tag" "$sid" 2>/dev/null \
      | glow --style dark -w "$W" - 2>/dev/null \
      || "$HOME/.config/television/agent-sessions.py" transcript "$tag" "$sid" 2>/dev/null \
        | bat -l md --color=always --paging=never --style=plain 2>/dev/null \
      || "$HOME/.config/television/agent-sessions.py" transcript "$tag" "$sid" 2>/dev/null
  else
    "$HOME/.config/television/agent-sessions.py" transcript "$tag" "$sid" 2>/dev/null \
      | bat -l md --color=always --paging=never --style=plain 2>/dev/null \
      || "$HOME/.config/television/agent-sessions.py" transcript "$tag" "$sid" 2>/dev/null
  fi
  ''',
]
header = "{split:\t:0}  {split:\t:6}  ({split:\t:3|split:/:-1})"

[ui]
input_header = "Live Agent Panes"

[ui.preview_panel]
size = 60

[keybindings]
enter = "actions:switch_pane"
alt-t = "actions:switch_pane"
alt-k = "actions:kill_pane"
ctrl-y = "actions:copy_target"
alt-p = "actions:copy_dir"
alt-r = "actions:copy_id"
alt-s = "actions:copy_specstory"

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Actions — keep shell glue minimal; any bare `{` would silently break TV's
# own placeholder substitution. See agent-sessions.toml line ~80.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

[actions.switch_pane]
description = "Switch tmux focus to that session/window/pane"
command = '''
target='{split:\t:6}'
[ -z "$target" ] && exit 0
session="${target%%:*}"
winpane="${target#*:}"
window="${winpane%.*}"
pane="${winpane#*.}"
# switch-client moves the attached client to the target session; select-window
# and select-pane scope down. We run as three steps so a missing pane (stale
# row) doesn't leave focus mid-jump.
tmux switch-client -t "$session" 2>/dev/null \
  && tmux select-window -t "$session:$window" 2>/dev/null \
  && tmux select-pane -t "$target" 2>/dev/null \
  || tmux display-message "agent-panes: pane $target no longer exists (stale row)"
'''
mode = "fork"

[actions.kill_pane]
description = "Kill the pane (confirm prompt)"
command = '''
target='{split:\t:6}'
[ -z "$target" ] && exit 0
printf 'Kill pane %s? [y/N] ' "$target"
read -r ans
case "$ans" in
  y|Y|yes|YES)
    tmux kill-pane -t "$target" 2>/dev/null \
      && echo "killed $target" \
      || echo "failed to kill $target (already gone?)"
    ;;
  *) echo "aborted" ;;
esac
echo "[Press Enter]"; read -r _
'''
mode = "execute"

[actions.copy_target]
description = "Copy pane target (session:win.pane) to clipboard"
command = '''
d='{split:\t:6}'
[ -z "$d" ] && exit 0
if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy
elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy
elif command -v xclip >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard
else printf '\033]52;c;%s\007' "$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" > /dev/tty
fi
'''
mode = "fork"

[actions.copy_id]
description = "Copy session ID to clipboard"
command = '''
d='{split:\t:2}'
[ -z "$d" ] && exit 0
if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy
elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy
elif command -v xclip >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard
else printf '\033]52;c;%s\007' "$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" > /dev/tty
fi
'''
mode = "fork"

[actions.copy_dir]
description = "Copy directory path to clipboard"
command = '''
d='{split:\t:3}'
[ -z "$d" ] && exit 0
if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy
elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy
elif command -v xclip >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard
else printf '\033]52;c;%s\007' "$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" > /dev/tty
fi
'''
mode = "fork"

[actions.copy_specstory]
description = "Copy .specstory/history/*.md path to clipboard"
command = '''
d='{split:\t:5}'
[ -z "$d" ] && exit 0
if command -v pbcopy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | pbcopy
elif command -v wl-copy >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | wl-copy
elif command -v xclip >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$d" | xclip -selection clipboard
else printf '\033]52;c;%s\007' "$(printf '%s' "$d" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" > /dev/tty
fi
'''
mode = "fork"
```
</details></tool-use>

[metadata]
name = "herdr-sesh"
description = "herdr workspace switcher + zoxide dir opener (herdr-aware sesh analog)"
requirements = ["herdr", "jq", "zoxide"]

[source]
command = [
  '''herdr workspace list 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.result.workspaces[]? | "ws\t\(.workspace_id)\t\(.label)  (\(.pane_count)p, \(.tab_count)t)"' ''',
  '''zoxide query -l 2>/dev/null | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"}{print "dir",$0,$0}' ''',
]
display = "{split:\t:2}"
output = "{split:\t:1}"

[preview]
command = '''
kind='{split:\t:0}'; ref='{split:\t:1}'
case "$kind" in
  ws)
    printf '\033[1mworkspace %s\033[0m\n\n' "$ref"
    herdr workspace get "$ref" 2>/dev/null | jq . 2>/dev/null \
      || herdr workspace get "$ref" 2>/dev/null
    ;;
  dir)
    printf '\033[1m%s\033[0m\n\n' "$ref"
    if command -v eza >/dev/null 2>&1; then eza -la --git --color=always "$ref" 2>/dev/null
    else ls -la "$ref" 2>/dev/null; fi
    ;;
esac
'''

[ui]
input_header = "herdr Workspaces / Dirs"

[keybindings]
enter = "actions:open"
ctrl-d = ["actions:close_ws", "reload_source"]
```
</details></tool-use>

<tool-use data-tool-type="shell" data-tool-name="Bash"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **Bash**</summary>
Map tv popup bindings to their Enter action modes

```bash
cd /Users/david/.local/share/chezmoi
echo "=== tmux popups launching tv ==="
grep -rhn "display-popup.*\"tv \|display-popup.*'tv \|tv [a-z-]*\"" dot_config/tmux/*.tmpl dot_config/tmux/*.sh dot_config/tmux/*.conf 2>/dev/null | grep -o "tv [a-z-]*" | sort -u
echo
echo "=== enter-action mode per channel ==="
for f in dot_config/television/cable/*.toml dot_config/television/cable/*.tmpl; do
  n=$(basename "$f" | sed 's/\.toml.*//;s/\.tmpl//')
  ent=$(grep -E "^enter = " "$f" 2>/dev/null | head -1 | sed 's/enter = //')
  [ -z "$ent" ] && { printf '%-22s %s\n' "$n" "(no enter binding -> tv prints & exits)"; continue; }
  act=$(printf '%s' "$ent" | grep -o 'actions:[a-z_]*' | head -1 | cut -d: -f2)
  if [ -z "$act" ]; then printf '%-22s enter=%s\n' "$n" "$ent"; continue; fi
  mode=$(awk -v a="[actions.$act]" 'index($0,a)==1{f=1} f&&/^mode = /{print $3; exit}' "$f")
  printf '%-22s enter=%-28s mode=%s\n' "$n" "$act" "${mode:-<default>}"
done
```

22:> **Install is version-blind; upgrades are yours to run.** The Linux ansible task gates on `herdr --version` returning non-zero — *"is it installed at all"*, not *"is it current"* — so a fresh box gets whatever is latest that day and `chezmoi apply` never touches it again. This is the repo's [install-vs-upgrade split](../this_repo/upgrades.md) working as designed, but herdr drifts faster than most because its config can outrun the binary (a `[[keys.command]]` using `type = "popup"`, added in 0.7.4, makes an older herdr reject **the entire keys block** — `reload-config` reports `status: "partial"` + `keeping current keys settings`, and only that one diagnostic line tells you).
25:- **Config**: `~/.config/herdr/config.toml` — chezmoi **`modify_` overlay** (`dot_config/herdr/modify_config.toml.tmpl` + managed body in `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml`). The overlay enforces our managed tables on every `chezmoi apply` while preserving whatever herdr writes back at runtime (see [Config management](#config-management-why-modify_)).
27:> **Why a package-managed herdr strands its own server — the reason macOS left Homebrew.** herdr's socket API is protocol-versioned, and a package-manager upgrade cannot restart the server, so after `brew upgrade herdr` every CLI call (and therefore every `tv herdr-*` channel, `hvibe`/`hcode`, and `[[keys.command]]` helper) fails `protocol_mismatch` until the server restarts — which kills all pane processes. `herdr update --handoff`, the live pane-preserving path, is **disabled on Homebrew/mise/Nix installs**, so a brew-installed herdr has no way to avoid that restart. This repo now installs the self-managed release binary on macOS too, which is what closes the gap; the pitfall below is kept because it still describes what happens on any box that has not been migrated (and `just upgrade-herdr` skips with instructions when it detects a package-managed install). Check with `herdr status` (`compatible:` / `restart_needed:`), not `herdr --version`. Full recovery matrix: [`pitfalls/herdr-brew-upgrade-strands-running-server.md`](https://github.com/daviddwlee84/dotfiles/blob/main/pitfalls/herdr-brew-upgrade-strands-running-server.md).

100:> **Two families of herdr env vars.** The `HERDR_ACTIVE_PANE_*` vars above are injected **only** into `[[keys.command]]` invocations. Scripts use `HERDR_ENV` as the "am I inside herdr?" test and inherit `HERDR_SOCKET_PATH` to target the current session — that's what `hvibe`/`hcode` rely on.

Advantages:

- **No `raw.githubusercontent.com` round-trip** for the wrapper script (only
  the deps still need PyPI, and PyPI is mirrorable; see below).
- **No `/dev/tty` re-exec gymnastics** — you're already in a real shell.
- **You can `git pull` and re-run** to test wrapper changes without re-running
  the curl pipeline.
- **You can `git checkout <branch>`** and run a feature branch's wrapper
  before merging.

The only thing `bootstrap.sh` does that `just bootstrap-local` doesn't is
auto-installing `uv`. If `uv` is missing on the new host, install it once:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
```

then `just bootstrap-local`.

## Behind GFW / corporate proxy

Three layers each need separate proxy/mirror config. The cheapest setup is a
local SOCKS/HTTP proxy (clash, v2ray, etc.) listening on `127.0.0.1:7890`:

- `herdr-sesh` (`dot_config/television/cable/herdr-sesh.toml`) — lists herdr sessions/workspaces + zoxide dirs; Enter dispatches `herdr session attach` / `herdr workspace focus` / `herdr workspace create --cwd` instead of `sesh connect` / `tmux switch-client`.
- `herdr-agent-panes` (`dot_config/television/cable/herdr-agent-panes.toml`) — same source as `agent-panes`, but switch/kill use `herdr pane focus` / `herdr pane close`.
- `herdr-review` (`dot_config/television/cable/herdr-review.toml`) — the **review-pending inbox**: lists only panes carrying the ⭐ flag (a non-empty `tokens.review`). Enter focuses the pane's workspace/tab and **keeps** the flag; `Alt+C` focuses **and** clears it ("mark read"). Bound to `prefix+i`. See the **Review-pending flag** section below.

The original tmux-bound `sesh` / `agent-panes` channels are left intact for coexistence.

三題都查完了，其中第 1 題有個關鍵岔路。

---

## 1. `prefix + T` 的 tv — 你有**兩個** `prefix+T`，會不會自動關掉不一樣

| 環境 | 綁定 | Enter action mode | 行為 |
|---|---|---|---|
| **tmux** | `keybindings.conf.tmpl:428` → `display-popup -E … "tv sesh"` | `mode = "execute"` | **已經會自動關掉** |
| **herdr** | `.chezmoitemplates/herdr/config.toml:214` → `type = "pane"`, `tv herdr-sesh` | `mode = "fork"` ← | **不會關**，picker pane 一直懸著 |

我實測驗證過（tv 0.15.6，用隔離的 tmux server + 真的 popup）：`execute` → tv 執行完 action 就退出；`fork` → tv 留著。tmux 那邊我用真的 `sesh` 跑了兩種情況（既有 session、以及從 `~/Downloads` 新建 session），popup 都正常關閉、`rc=0`。

所以你遇到的應該是 **herdr 版**。已修 `dot_config/television/cable/herdr-sesh.toml`：`[actions.open]` 的 `mode` 從 `fork` 改成 `execute`，並已 apply + 用 shim 驗證（tv 退出，`herdr workspace focus ws-1` 照樣有跑）。`ctrl-d`（`close_ws`）**故意保留 `fork`**，因為它跟 `reload_source` 搭配，tv 必須活著才能重畫清單。

原因很直接：herdr 的 `type = "pane"` 只有在指令結束時才會消失（跟 `prefix+G` 的 lazygit 同一個機制），所以 tv 不退出 = pane 不關。

**還沒動、要不要一起改？** 這幾個 Enter 也是 `fork`，同樣不會關：`herdr-agent-panes`(`prefix+a`)、`herdr-review`(`prefix+i`)、以及 tmux 側的 `agent-panes`(`prefix+a`)、`agent-wakeup`。這些留著 `fork` 可能是刻意的（分診時連續跳、不離開 picker），所以我沒動——要改跟我說。

## 2. bashrc 被 bootstrap 改又被蓋回去 — 是 expected，而且沒有東西遺失

`run_once_before_00_bootstrap.sh.tmpl:391-406` 追加那兩行。關鍵是 `run_once_**before**_`：它在 chezmoi 寫下任何 dotfile **之前**跑，純粹是 apply 完成前那個空窗期的墊片（`chezmoi`/`uv`/`mise` 都在 `~/.local/bin`，萬一 apply 中途掛掉你還找得到它們）。

apply 之後由 `dot_bashrc.tmpl:114` → `dot_config/shell/00_exports.sh.tmpl:26` 接手，那行已經是 `PATH="$HOME/.dotfiles/bin:$HOME/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"`，**兩種 shell 都吃得到**。腳本裡「dotfiles only wire this up in zsh」那句註解已經過時了。

正常 `chezmoi init --apply` 兩步在同一次呼叫裡發生，你不會看到中間狀態；會看到那個 diff 表示你剛好卡在兩步之間（或上次 apply 被中斷）。跑一次 `chezmoi apply` 就沒了。你這台 Mac 的 `~/.bashrc` 尾巴已經沒有那個 block 了。

> 我原本想順手修那句過時註解，但**改 `run_once_` 的內容會換掉它的 hash，導致全 fleet 下次 apply 重跑整個 bootstrap** — 為了一句註解不值得，所以我 revert 了，改寫進 docs。要修的話建議跟其他 bootstrap 改動一起搭車。

## 3. docs 沒有寫怎麼看方向 — 現在有了

之前**沒有**任何文件解釋左右。唯一寫過的地方是 `.chezmoi.toml.tmpl:210` 的一行註解，而那不會出現在任何 docs 裡；`cheatsheet.md` 只寫「Preview what would change」。

我在沙箱裡用隔離的 `--source` / `--destination` 實測確認方向後，加了一節 **`docs/this_repo/cheatsheet.md` → Reading `chezmoi diff`**（含 zh-TW）：

| Unified | 並排（delta） | 意義 |
|---|---|---|
| `--- a/`、`-` | **左** | **這台機器現在的真實檔案** |
| `+++ b/`、`+` | **右** | **chezmoi 即將寫入的內容** |

一句話記法：**跟 `git diff` 一樣是「舊 → 新」= 「機器現況 → apply 之後」**。左邊紅 = apply 會刪掉；右邊綠 = apply 會加上。
